donorUnits.mappedAdaptation: Translate the permission preflight structure (no capture/input begins unless a probe proves its TCC service), the trust-settling deadline semantics, and the snapshot cache policy (a cached permission answer is never presented as fresh; bounded newest-snapshot retention) into the computer-use lane's authority gate: consent records re-check #471 probe freshness inside their window, frames follow the bounded newest-frame cache policy, and ScreenCapturePermissionPreflightSafety's rule — capture refuses closed when the recording grant cannot be proven — becomes typed capability_unavailable while the native helper stays deferred. Scripted runners replay the outcome matrices; no real capture or input runs in CI.

Mine only the host-side plumbing shape (a supervised runtime host owning lane lifecycle plus a rendering seam that projects desktop snapshots into a bounded client view); the Electron/remote-desktop transport is replaced by Adea's desktop-frames-v1 stream, the M10 gate, and the #472 consent gate. Donor code is not copied verbatim from this unit.
